name: Mole Prospector

criteria: Every source vertex and triangle remains in its own declared local piece. No byte-substituted sibling is accepted.

Both original meshes retain separate boring heads, rectangular tool-cradle members and independent well domains. The detailed original retains eight individually bounded collars which the native candidate omits.
Read the own detailed visuals and textures through the ordinary Showroom without changing original coordinates, winding, face materials or UVs.
Independently certify both source-surface directions, tool cradle gap probe and both full controlled sweep paths, and strict SH028 lip witness.
Retain the distinction between the annular detailed collars and their enclosing convex disks; do not report exact annular clearance. The central actual tool-cradle path remains independently clear.

sourceOnly.checks: Run all source pins, fixture projection certificates and negative mutations.

acceptance: Core fit tests pass on the assigned platforms, including independent SH028 station lip/contact, aligned entry, off-aperture and tool cradle pass and actual source contact cases.
The SH017-controlled World passes five actual approach routes and source/snapshot invariants.
Current SH008 source/Showroom tests remain green after the common renderer extension.
Ordinary Showroom native capture shows SH017 alone and in Compare, with source appearance, twin boring heads, eight collars, rectangular tool cradle and upper control bay visible from rotated views.
The ordinary Ship Showroom still refuses unadmitted exchange. Existing hulls and saves remain intact.

reviewEvidence.invocation: Each Metal test is ignored by default. Set its directory variable to a distinct new absolute directory and run cargo test --locked -p meridian-desktop <test> -- --ignored --exact --nocapture.
reviewEvidence.minimumAndCacheReceipt: Full-target PPMs, matching independent -direct.ppm references, model-panes.tsv and rgb-measurements.tsv. Each isolated image must be nonblack, with at least 2 logical pixels of in-pane clearance. Compare and both mixed orders must match exact full-target isolated RGB union, with direct original render identity and repeat/return checks.
reviewEvidence.scope: Offscreen native model only. No GPU timing, native window resizing, compositor output or ordinary placement.

remaining: Owned execution of the controlled World regressions, ordinary placement, acquisition, paid fitting, crew and player admission
Native window/compositor, GPU timing, actual as-built materials, hardware volume, loaded mass and role population.
